title: Potentiometer
text: Simulink controlled potentiometer, {Potentiometer type} sets Curve type of potentiometer; {Minimum resistance} sets the minimum input resistance of potentiometer, {Maximum resistance} sets the maximum input resistance of potentiometer 1e6 and {Percentage of resistance at half wiper} sets the maximum input resistance of potentiometer positive. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Minimum resistance
params.values: Minimum input resistance of potentiometer 10 Ohm (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Maximum resistance
params.values: Maximum input resistance of potentiometer 1e6 Ohm (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Potentiometer type
params.values: Curve type of potentiometer Linear (default) | Logarithmic | Antilog

params.name: Percentage of resistance at half wiper
params.values: Maximum input resistance of potentiometer positive scalar
